$comment: Reference source repositories for evaluation only. NOT application dependencies. Restore with: npm run refs:fetch. Record checked-out SHAs with: npm run refs:lock.

packages.name: cpal
packages.capabilities: Cross-platform audio device enumeration and input/output stream callbacks (CoreAudio, WASAPI, ASIO, ALSA, AAudio, iOS).
packages.integration: Direct crates.io dependency of crates/voiceloop-engine (already adopted).
packages.limitations: Raw device I/O only: no mixing, resampling, routing, or duplex synchronisation. Input and output are separate streams with independent clocks.

packages.name: midir
packages.capabilities: Cross-platform realtime MIDI input/output (CoreMIDI, WinMM/WinRT, ALSA, JACK, Web MIDI).
packages.integration: Direct crates.io dependency when MIDI work begins (Milestone 1/4).
packages.limitations: Input callbacks run on a backend thread with host timestamps; mapping to the audio clock is our job. No MIDI file parsing.

packages.name: rtrb
packages.capabilities: Wait-free single-producer single-consumer ring buffer suitable for the realtime audio thread.
packages.integration: Direct crates.io dependency of crates/voiceloop-engine (already adopted).
packages.limitations: SPSC only. Fixed capacity chosen at construction.

packages.name: fundsp
packages.capabilities: Composable audio graph notation, oscillators, filters, envelopes, reverb, delay, dynamics; realtime-safe graph processing.
packages.integration: Candidate crates.io dependency for synths/effects in Milestone 4. Evaluate allocation behaviour of graph edits first.
packages.limitations: API evolves between versions; heavy generic types increase compile time. No pitch detection or time stretching.

packages.name: rubato
packages.capabilities: Synchronous and asynchronous (sinc / polynomial) sample-rate conversion, realtime-capable with preallocated buffers.
packages.integration: Candidate crates.io dependency for device-rate vs project-rate conversion and clock drift correction.
packages.limitations: Resampling only; not a pitch shifter or time stretcher.

packages.name: tracktion_engine
packages.capabilities: Full DAW engine: Edit/Track/Clip model, tempo and time-signature sequence, transport, audio and MIDI recording, loop recording, clip launcher, plugin hosting, rendering.
packages.integration: Architectural reference. Direct use would mean a C++/JUCE engine and GPL-3.0 or a paid licence.
packages.limitations: Requires JUCE (git submodule, skipped in shallow retrieval). Large C++ codebase; GPL/commercial licensing.

packages.name: juce
packages.license: AGPL-3.0 or commercial JUCE 9 EULA (examples ISC)
packages.capabilities: C++ application framework: audio device manager, audio/MIDI I/O, DSP module, plugin hosting (VST3/AU/LV2), GUI, iOS/macOS/Windows targets.
packages.integration: Architectural reference. Direct use implies replacing the Rust engine with C++ and AGPL or a paid licence.
packages.limitations: Large. Licensing obligations for closed distribution.

packages.name: waveform-playlist
packages.capabilities: Browser multitrack waveform display, selection, trimming, fades, recording, mixing and export (Web Audio).
packages.integration: UI reference for waveform rendering and editing interactions; audio paths are Web Audio and would not be reused.
packages.limitations: Web Audio engine; not suitable as our realtime engine.

packages.name: mloop
packages.capabilities: Browser live looper: recording modes, overdub, sync, undo.
packages.integration: Behavioural reference only (AGPL-3.0). Do not copy or port code.

packages.name: pitchy
packages.capabilities: McLeod Pitch Method fundamental-frequency detection with clarity (confidence) output.
packages.integration: Algorithm reference; MPM is straightforward to implement natively (or use the Rust pitch-detection crate).

packages.name: essentia.js
packages.capabilities: WASM build of Essentia: onset detection, beat tracking, key, pitch (YIN, Melodia), spectral features.
packages.integration: Reference only unless AGPL obligations or an Essentia commercial licence are accepted.
packages.limitations: AGPL-3.0. WASM in the webview would put analysis on the UI side, against our architecture.

packages.name: signalsmith-stretch
packages.capabilities: High-quality polyphonic time stretching and pitch shifting (header-only C++).
packages.integration: Candidate for direct native integration via a small C++ shim + cc/bindgen, or an existing Rust binding crate.
packages.limitations: C++ build integration required; depends on signalsmith-linear (separate repo).

packages.name: rnnoise
packages.capabilities: RNN-based speech noise suppression at 48 kHz, 10 ms frames.
packages.integration: Optional, user-enabled, offline/clean-up processing only. Pure-Rust port (nnnoiseless) exists.
packages.limitations: Speech-trained: damages musical transients and sustained tones. Model weights are downloaded separately (not retrieved).

packages.name: tone.js
packages.capabilities: Musical transport (BPM, time signature, loop points), lookahead scheduling, Time notation ('4n', '1m'), synths, effects.
packages.integration: Reference for musical time abstractions and transport API design. Not used for realtime audio.
packages.limitations: Web Audio based; scheduling depends on the browser audio clock and JS timers.
